verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a hardware system-on-chip. An official CLI for AI-native workflows is a software-product axis, so the question is a category error for a processor. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships a CLI: MLX, Metal and PyTorch backends are frameworks that run on it, not an official CLI of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
